subject: Mid atlantic ridge
topic: The longest mountain range on Earth isn't on land. It's at the bottom of the ocean.
script:
The longest mountain range on Earth isn't on land. It's at the bottom of the ocean.
It's part of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
It runs about sixteen thousand kilometers, from the Arctic almost all the way to Antarctica.
Here, two tectonic plates are slowly pulling apart.
Magma rises up into the gap, building brand new seafloor.
In a few places, the ridge even rises above the waves. Iceland is one of them.
Its steep walls, vents and seamounts are home to life found nowhere else.
In twenty twenty-two, NOAA scientists explored it, and found a golden field of coral.
Did you know this mountain range was hiding underwater?
pkg_title: Earth's LONGEST Mountain Range Is Underwater ⛰️ #Shorts
